drc.independent: On 27 June 2023, the UN Security Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2688 (2023), extending the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024. A review for further extension is scheduled for 1 July 2024. The Council requests a midterm report to the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group shall submit monthly updates, excluding report-due months.
drc.interactive: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2688 (2023), extending the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024. A review for further extension is scheduled for 1 July 2024. Experts must submit a midterm report to the Council by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024, providing monthly updates to the Committee except during report-due months.
drc.verbatim: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024, intending to review and potentially further extend it by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group shall submit monthly updates to the Committee, excluding the two report-due months.

unami.independent: On 30 May 2023, the Council adopted Resolution 2682 (2023), extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General is requested to report on UNAMI's fulfilment of responsibilities every four months. A strategic review by 31 March 2024 is mandated, requiring consultations with Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional bodies, experts, and civil society. unami.interactive: On 30 May 2023, the Council adopted Resolution 2682 (2023), extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General is requested to report on UNAMI's fulfilment of responsibilities every four months. An independent strategic review is due by 31 March 2024. Consultations include Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, experts, civil society, and Kuwait.
unami.verbatim: Resolution 2682 (2023) extended the UNAMI mandate to 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI fulfilment every four months and conduct an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024, consulting Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society, and Kuwait. Iraq's Government expressed support for the review in a letter dated 18 May 2023.
